en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a very large old pine tree enclosed by a low fence in a rural landscape. A child and an adult stand on either side of the tree, emphasizing its size. In the background are fields, farm buildings, and a flagpole with a Scandinavian-style flag. Text is printed along the bottom edge of the image, and a handwritten-style signature appears in the lower right corner.
